text:
emma (PM): hey team - we got a new enterprise ask from HorizonRetail. They want session-level context + per-tenant routing by EOD next quarter. need to recalibrate our Q2 RICE scores. asking for quick opinions on impact vs effort before i adjust the board :thinking:

jordan (Eng): rough read: impact high but engineering effort also pretty big. multi-tenant routing touches runtime, routing policy, and tests. estimate -> effort=8/10 unless we scope down.

kai (Data): metric perspective: if Horizon is pilot, top-line MRR uplift is uncertain. i would score impact 6.5/10 based on projected conversion from pilot data. we should tie impact to a measurable launch criterion (e.g., pilot signed + 3% conversion).

noah (Design): UX-wise we can ship a minimal control panel for per-tenant routing quickly. push complexity to backend. that reduces effort a bit if we accept a CLI-first admin for v1.

sara (AE): client needs isolation guarantees for compliance. they're flexible on timeline if we can promise audit logs + clear SLA language. that changes risk profile. they prefer canary with one tenant first.

jordan (Eng): agree on canary. technically we can do a phased rollout: 1) routing flag + audit logs (4w), 2) scale tests + autoscale policy (6w). if we split like that, effort for MVP becomes 4 instead of 8.

emma (PM): proposal: treat this as a two-slice initiative. for RICE, i'm thinking: Reach=0.1 (pilot), Impact=6, Confidence=60%, Effort=4 for MVP slice. that yields a RICE score(approx). any objections?

kai (Data): small note: confidence feels optimistic at 60%. recommend 50% until we validate pilot assumptions. also suggest capturing baseline eval metrics now.

noah (Design): +1 to two-slice. add launch criterion: admin flag + audit log visible in console, and 1 tenant onboarded in canary. otherwise hold on additional rollouts.

sara (AE): i'll push for a contract clause to lock the pilot. also will ask Horizon to accept the phased delivery plan.

emma (PM): cool. action items: 1) jordan to draft engineering split and estimate by EOD tomorrow, 2) noah to mock minimal admin UI by Thu, 3) kai to pull baseline metrics and draft success metric doc, 4) sara to confirm pilot commitment. we'll reconvene async and i'll update the RICE board. thanks :rocket:

deploy-bot: note: created task #PRD-412 in product board for "HorizonRetail per-tenant routing (MVP)"

emma (PM): if no major objections by 24h i'll update scores. want to avoid redoing prioritization meeting for this one.

jordan (Eng): fine by me. i'll try to find ways to reuse existing routing infra to lower risk.

kai (Data): leaving a comment on the success metric doc with suggested A/B targets.

emma (PM): perfect — closing thread.
